# Harvest

Harvest is a time-tracking and invoicing tool designed for teams and freelancers, helping them log billable hours, manage projects, and streamline payments

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/harvest/.

## Actions

- **Create Client**: Create a new client.
- **Create Client Contact**: Create a new client contact.
- **Create Estimate**: Create a new estimate.
- **Create Estimate Item Category**: Create a new estimate item category in harvest.
- **Create Estimate Message**: Create a new message for an estimate.
- **Create Expense**: Create a new expense entry.
- **Create Invoice**: Create a new invoice.
- **Create Invoice Item Category**: Create a new invoice item category.
- **Create Invoice Message**: Create a new message for an invoice.
- **Create Invoice Payment**: Create a new payment on an invoice.
- **Create Project**: Create a new project.
- **Create Task**: Create a new task.
- **Create Time Entry**: Create a new time entry.
- **Create User**: Create a new user.
- **Delete Client**: Delete a client.
- **Delete Client Contact**: Delete a client contact.
- **Delete Estimate**: Delete an estimate.
- **Delete Estimate Message**: Delete an estimate message.
- **Delete Invoice**: Delete an invoice.
- **Delete Invoice Item Category**: Delete an invoice item category.
- **Delete Invoice Message**: Delete a message from an invoice.
- **Delete Invoice Payment**: Delete an invoice payment.
- **Delete Project**: Delete a project.
- **Delete Task**: Delete a task.
- **Delete Time Entry**: Delete a time entry.
- **Delete User**: Delete a user.
- **Get Client**: Retrieve a specific client by id.
- **Get Client Contact**: Retrieve a specific client contact.
- **Get Company Info**: Retrieve information about the authenticated user's company.
- **Get Estimate**: Retrieve a specific estimate by id.
- **Get Invoice**: Retrieve a specific invoice by id.
- **Get Project**: Retrieve a specific harvest project by id.
- **Get Task**: Retrieve a specific task by id.
- **Get Time Entry**: Retrieve a single time entry by id.
- **Get User**: Retrieve a specific user by id.
- **List Client Contacts**: List client contacts.
- **List Clients**: List clients.
- **List Estimate Messages**: List messages for an estimate.
- **List Expense Categories**: List expense categories.
- **List Invoice Item Categories**: Retrieve invoice item categories.
- **List Invoice Messages**: List messages associated with a given invoice.
- **List Invoice Payments**: Retrieve payments for a specific invoice.
- **List Invoices**: List invoices.
- **List projects**: List projects.
- **List Tasks**: List tasks.
- **List Time Entries**: Retrieve a list of time entries.
- **List Users**: List users.
- **Update Client**: Update an existing client.
- **Update Client Contact**: Update a client contact.
- **Update Company Info**: Update information about the company.
- **Update Estimate**: Update an existing estimate.
- **Update Estimate Item Category**: Update an estimate item category.
- **Update Expense**: Update an existing expense.
- **Update Invoice**: Update an existing invoice.
- **Update Project**: Update an existing project.

- **Update Time Entry**: Update an existing time entry.
- **Update User**: Update an existing user.
